title: Hollow and Choir Anew
author: Quentin Lockridge
blurb: Kestrel Thackeray, a cartographer of unmapped realms, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
